parts:
If you're asking how to embed Shiny apps in an existing website, the easy answer is iframes--that's how we did it for that page on rstudio.com. First you deploy your Shiny application to a Shiny server (or on our beta hosting service, glimmer.rstudio.com), then add to your page an iframe that points to your application's URL:

<iframe src="http://glimmer.rstudio.com/rstudio/faithful/" style="border: 1px solid #CCC; width: 440px; height: 500px"></iframe>

If you need a glimmer.rstudio.com account you can apply for one here.
